item.title: The Baldwin Group And CAC Group Announce $1.026 Billion Merger To Form Publicly Traded Insurance Broker
item.description: The Baldwin Group has entered into a definitive agreement to merge with CAC Group in a transaction valued at $1.026 billion upfront, creating what is expected to become the largest majority-colleague-owned, publicly traded insurance brokerage firm in the United States. The Seattle-based company intends to shrink permitting cycles from months to weeks and ultimately to days by unifying chats, emails, voice interactions, plans, and workflows into a single conversational system. item.title: Versant Expands Free-to-Watch Portfolio With Acquisition of Free TV Networks
item.description: Versant has reached a definitive agreement to acquire Free TV Networks in a deal that will expand the company’s entertainment footprint and strengthen its presence across free, ad-supported distribution channels. The transaction, announced on December 4, 2025, comes as Comcast prepares to spin off Versant as an independent public media company in early 2026. item.title: Clifford Chance Names Mark-Jan Arends As New Managing Partner For Amsterdam Office

item.title: Squire Acquires HintonBurdick To Expand Intermountain West Footprint
item.description: Squire, one of Utah’s fastest-growing and nationally recognized accounting firms, has announced its acquisition of regional CPA firm HintonBurdick. The deal, which becomes effective January 1, 2026, significantly expands Squire’s geographic presence and strengthens its position as one of the largest CPA firms in Utah. HintonBurdick operates offices across Utah, Arizona, and Nevada, giving the combined organization a broader reach and deeper service capabilities throughout the Intermountain West.
